sanskrit_verse:
संधिन्यनिर्दशावत्सागोपयः परिवर्जयेत् ।
औष्ट्रम् ऐकशफं स्त्रैणम् आरण्यकम् अथाविकम् ॥१-१७०
transliteration: saṃdhinyanirdaśāvatsāgopayaḥ parivarjayet | auṣṭram aikaśaphaṃ straiṇam āraṇyakam athāvikam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One must avoid animals that are diseased, emaciated, barren, or in season; likewise, camels, one-hoofed creatures, females dedicated to others, wild animals, and those without wool.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority stems from discernment of fitness for use
Causation lies in conscious selection aligned with dharma
Capacity-based responsibility requires rejection of harm-inducing entities
Restoration logic demands exclusion of elements disrupting harmony
Consciousness alignment necessitates avoidance of impure or unfit objects
executable_legal_axioms: IF animal.is_diseased OR animal.is_emaciated OR animal.is_barren OR animal.in_season THEN action.avoid = TRUE
IF entity.type IN ['camel', 'one-hoofed'] THEN usage.permitted = FALSE
IF female.dedicated_to != user THEN access.allowed = FALSE
IF animal.fiber_type != 'wool' AND context.requires_wool THEN utilization.approved = FALSE
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving resource allocation or ritual conduct, the Court must apply thresholds based on inherent fitness rather than mere availability. Authority resides in recognizing dharmic suitability over utilitarian convenience.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes clear perceptual evidence of unfitness. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how improper selection leads to disorder. Responsibility aligns with capacity to choose rightly. No punitive consequence arises—only a natural cessation of misalignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Reintroduce only ritually fit resources into sacred use
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: User must verify fitness before engagement
Capacity Restoration: Educate selectors on signs of dharmic suitability
Integrity Reintegration: Purify space where unfit elements were introduced
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this directive flows as pure Dharma. Misalignment dissolves through conscious refusal. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
